description: Environment setup + establish and RECORD the workstream-1 BASELINE before changing anything. Add the re-runnable cold-load measurement harness (scripts/measure-load.mjs) using playwright-core (USER-APPROVED devDependency) pointed at the on-machine Chrome for Testing. Record baseline cold-load transferred bytes for the landing page and each of the four demo routes, the largest JS chunk (raw + gzip), the per-directory breakdown of public/, and fixed-camera screenshots of each 3D scene. This is the MANDATORY first step; no production code or assets change in this feature.
steps: Confirm baseline build works: `npm install`, `npm run lint` (must be clean except the ONE known @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx), `npm run build` (static export into out/ must succeed and all four demo routes + landing must prerender).

Add playwright-core to devDependencies in package.json (run `npm install --save-dev playwright-core`). Do NOT download browsers; the harness must use executablePath pointing at the existing browser (resolve via env override or /usr/local/bin/chrome -> /opt/playwright/chromium-1232/chrome-linux64/chrome). Confirm nothing runtime/browser-shipped changed.

Create scripts/measure-load.mjs adapting tireshop's harness (studied at /projects/sandbox/tireshop, commit 977b809 scripts/measure-load.mjs — do NOT modify tireshop). It must: serve the built out/ over a local static http server, respecting the /frankfabric base path (Next static export writes /frankfabric-prefixed URLs into the HTML in a production build, so serve out/ at the /frankfabric/ mount, or build with NODE_ENV so URLs match — verify the served route actually loads assets, ready=true); launch headless Chrome via playwright-core chromium.launch({ executablePath, args:['--no-sandbox','--use-gl=angle','--use-angle=swiftshader','--ignore-gpu-blocklist'] }); disable disk cache; sum transferred bytes of every response and break down by file extension; navigate to a route passed via --route (default '/'); wait for the scene canvas to be present and a few frames to settle; capture a fixed-camera screenshot clipped to the canvas bounding box with animations disabled; write docs/perf/<label>.json (totalBytes, byType, per-resource list, ready flag, errors) and docs/perf/<label>.png. Accept --dir, --route, --label, --out, --port flags. If the browser can't launch, print how to fix and exit non-zero.

Run the harness for the landing page and each of the four demo routes against the CURRENT (unmodified) build, writing baseline artifacts to docs/perf/ (e.g. baseline-landing.{json,png}, baseline-wardrobe.{json,png}, baseline-chef.{json,png}, baseline-coach.{json,png}, baseline-pet.{json,png}). For the wardrobe route also record the default-view cold load (the harness should capture the initial styled avatar; garment swapping is on-demand).

Record the largest JS chunk raw + gzip sizes from out/_next/static/chunks (baseline largest chunk observed = 913347 B raw / 238953 B gzip on the wardrobe route) and the per-directory public/ breakdown (`du`).

Write docs/perf/BASELINE.md summarizing: the machine/runtime (Node 22, Linux sandbox) and browser (Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.10, headless, swiftshader), the per-route cold-load transferred bytes, the largest JS chunk raw+gzip, the public/ per-directory breakdown, and note the UNREFERENCED dead asset public/models/characters/schnauzer/RETOPO_COL_2k_0.png (4.7MB, not fetched at runtime — the .glb embeds its own texture). Commit docs/perf/ evidence + the harness. Verify .gitignore already excludes out/, .next/, node_modules/, and add assets-src/ to .gitignore (source-of-truth tree for the compressor, created in FEAT-002).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` is clean except the single known font warning; `npm run build` static export succeeds with all five pages prerendered.

scripts/measure-load.mjs runs headless against out/ and reports ready=true (assets actually loaded under the base path) for the landing page and all four demo routes, producing a docs/perf/*.json byte report + docs/perf/*.png screenshot for each.
docs/perf/BASELINE.md records per-route cold-load transferred bytes, largest JS chunk raw+gzip (913347/238953), the public/ per-directory breakdown, and the machine+browser measured on.
playwright-core appears ONLY in devDependencies; no runtime dependency or browser-shipped code was added.
No production source or public asset bytes were changed in this feature (baseline is pristine).
verification: npm run lint && npm run build
node scripts/measure-load.mjs --dir out --route / --label baseline-landing  (and --route /projects/digital-wardrobe/ etc.) → ready=true, JSON+PNG written
git status confirms out/ .next/ node_modules/ assets-src/ are untracked/ignored
findings:
BASELINE RECORDED. Machine: Linux sandbox, Node v22.23.2. Browser: Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.10 headless, ANGLE+SwiftShader (--no-sandbox --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --ignore-gpu-blocklist), viewport 1280x900. Build gate green: npm run lint clean except the one expected @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx; npm run build static-exports all 5 pages.

Cold-load transferred bytes (ready=true, unresolvedFailures=0 for all): landing / = 1,157,888 B (1.158 MB, no canvas); wardrobe /projects/digital-wardrobe/ = 18,671,336 B (18.671 MB) — the worst route; chef /projects/chef-chatbot/ = 2,571,811 B (2.572 MB); coach /projects/coach-trainer/ = 2,431,115 B (2.431 MB); pet /projects/virtual-pet/ = 14,327,684 B (14.328 MB, dominated by schnauzer.glb 12,462,120 B with embedded texture).

Largest JS chunk: 913,347 B raw / 238,951 B gzip (three/@react-three heavy). Preloaded ONLY by out/projects/digital-wardrobe/index.html (chunk 3spa3a6p4vdyu.js) because components/WardrobeBuilder.tsx statically imports the OPTIONS runtime value from the three-heavy WardrobeScene module — that value-import is the FEAT-003 split lever.

public/ on disk: 61M total; models 56M (drophunter 38M, schnauzer 17M, swedish-chef 632K, coach 608K); animations 2.5M; wardrobe 2.3M; images 284K; videos 100K.

DEAD ASSET confirmed: public/models/characters/schnauzer/RETOPO_COL_2k_0.png = 4,884,566 B is UNREFERENCED at runtime (pet route fetches only schnauzer.glb, which embeds its own texture; the only source mention is a comment in PetScene.tsx). Safe to remove in FEAT-002.

HARNESS NOTES for FEAT-002/003: scripts/measure-load.mjs serves out/ under the /frankfabric/ base path (strips the prefix), disables disk cache, sums response bytes, waits for <canvas> + 4s settle on 3D routes (2s on canvas-less), screenshots the canvas bbox with animations disabled. Readiness reconciles ERR_ABORTED against successful 200s (large VRM/GLB duplicate fetches get aborted at teardown but the primary request completes) and ignores the browser's implicit /favicon.ico 404. Drive it via CHROME_PATH env (default /usr/local/bin/chrome). Flags: --dir --route --label --out --port --base. playwright-core is a devDependency ONLY; runtime dependencies unchanged. No production source or public asset byte changed in this feature (baseline pristine).
